description:
One run's answer for one cell. Key: (case_set, case_id, policy_world, quantity, entity, run).

Rules: the status is `answered` exactly when `value` is not None, and an answered value
keeps the source's `raw` text. A value carries no tolerance. `producer` defaults to
"not_stated"; "model" asserts that the source says the model itself produced the value.

entity.description: Which person or unit in the case; "" means the case's single unit.

producer.description: What produced the value: "not_stated" when the source does not say; "model" when the source says the model itself produced it; "harness:<formula>" when harness code computed it from model outputs.

raw.description: The answer as the source holds it, as text.

source_status.description: The source tool's own status word, kept as written.

status.description: What the run returned for the cell.

status_detail.description: More about the status, such as error text.

value.description: The answer as parsed; null unless the status is answered.

title: Value
